newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-WMC says no plan for equity issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-WMC says no plan for equity issue.

text.p: WMC Ltd said on Friday it has no plans to seek funds from an equity raising to fund development of a proposed A$650 million fertiliser project in Queensland.

"We believe we can finance these matters without a share issue," WMC's managing director Hugh Morgan told reporters, referring to the fertiliser project and the company's A$1.25 billion Olympic Dam copper and uranium mine expansion.
Morgan said he expected a final decision on the fertiliser project within two months. If the project is given the go-ahead, operations could commence in late 1999, or early 2000.
The expansion of Olympic Dam was approved earlier this year.
